title: Static Hook Beak and Feather Wing Griffin
description: One newly authored complete stylized griffin character in a fixed four-foot pose. A deep tawny lion torso and two bent rear legs with rounded whole paws combine with a tall ivory feathered neck/skull, a downward hooked beak and two long bird forelegs ending in real cleft three-toe feet. Two entire raised feather-fan wings have projecting primary tips and separate rooted overlapping coverts, not scalloped bat membranes. A long thin curved lion tail ends in a volumetric tuft. Dark lateral eyes are seated into the head. All body sections, head proportions, feather outlines and limbs are newly drawn, not a modified old dragon body with an owl head attached; no old mesh is imported. Three opaque PBR materials, metre Z-up and full horizontal-bounds-centred four-foot ground origin. One static character prop and zero scenes. Fictional game-art appearance only; no biological accuracy, flight, locomotion, physical balance, animal care, manufacture or safety. Rigging, animation, interactions, collision and living functions are not produced or verified.
